question: Which element was arbitrarily assigned a value of 4.0 in the 'Halogens' section in 1922 by Linus Pauling, an American scientist?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fluorine**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fluorine is the element that was arbitrarily assigned a value of 4.0 by Linus Pauling in the 'Halogens' section in 1922.
 
• Linus Pauling was an American chemist who developed the concept of electronegativity, and he assigned fluorine the highest electronegativity among all elements.
